purpose: Reference for separating valid pattern geometry from insufficient trading potential
desired_behavior: Detect the structure as a valid Falling Wedge when geometry requirements are satisfied
Do not invalidate good geometry merely because the measured move is small
Evaluate trading potential separately from Geometry Quality
Allow low-potential structures to be suppressed from Telegram without rejecting their geometry
Do not establish a hard minimum potential threshold from this single reference
notes: Positive geometry but possible negative trade-opportunity example. Approximately 0.51 percent potential is preserved as calibration evidence, not as a finalized filtering threshold.
